note: Wednesday Cantonese speaking: 事 + 合作 warm-up, re-drill why-lines (hard04y), café/合作 recap, then 4 new intro add-ons (wed04y). Record the 1-min intro twice. Hub Play may be silent — use the mp3. 讲出声，猫头鹰在听。

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat 低平调) three times, then 合作 (hap6 zok3) three times. Keep 事 low and flat — not mid like 試 si3.
tasks.script:
事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6
合作 hap6 zok3 · 合作 hap6 zok3 · 合作 hap6 zok3
(試 si3 = mid; 事 si6 sits lower. 作 zok3 as in 工作 gung1 zok3.)

tasks.title: words.hk 粵典 · look up 研究 / 強項 / 課題 (Jyutping + examples)
Shadow ×3: new intro add-ons (mp3 in chat: wed04_intro_addons.mp3) · then why-lines (tue03_yue_lines.mp3) ×3

lines.text: 我喺港大做過老齡化友善城市嘅研究。
lines.gloss: ngo5 hai2 Gong2 Daai6 zou6 gwo3 lou5 ling4 faa3 jau5 sin6 sing4 si5 ge3 jin4 gau3
lines.translation: I did ageing-friendly city research at HKU.

lines.text: 我嘅強項係數據分析同解決問題。
lines.gloss: ngo5 ge3 koeng4 hong6 hai6 sou3 geoi3 fan1 sik1 tung4 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4
lines.translation: My strengths are data analysis and problem-solving.

lines.text: 有，我想問吓團隊而家最重要嘅研究課題係咩。
lines.gloss: jau5, ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa5 tyun4 deoi6 ji4 gaa1 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 jin4 gau3 fo1 tai4 hai6 me1
lines.translation: Yes — I'd like to ask what the team's top research topic is now. (reply to 有冇問題問我哋)

lines.text: 多謝你哋今日嘅時間，我好期待有機會加入。
lines.gloss: do1 ze6 nei5 dei6 gam1 jat6 ge3 si4 gaan3, ngo5 hou2 kei4 doi6 jau5 gei1 wui6 gaa1 jap6
lines.translation: Thank you for your time today; I look forward to a chance to join. (時 si4)

tasks.prompt: 1-min Chinese self-intro + why-this-job: record → listen → re-record once. Point first (who you are / what you did), then reason, then one example. Watch 事 si6, 時間 si4 gaan3, 合作 hap6 zok3, 職位 zik1 wai6. Check the script after.
tasks.script:
Model skeleton (swap in your own details, keep the tones):
我喺港大做過老齡化友善城市嘅研究。ngo5 hai2 Gong2 Daai6 zou6 gwo3 lou5 ling4 faa3 jau5 sin6 sing4 si5 ge3 jin4 gau3
我有地理空間數據分析嘅經驗。ngo5 jau5 dei6 lei5 hung1 gaan1 sou3 geoi3 fan1 sik1 ge3 ging1 jim6
我嘅強項係數據分析同解決問題。ngo5 ge3 koeng4 hong6 hai6 sou3 geoi3 fan1 sik1 tung4 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4
我想做呢份工，因為我鍾意用數據幫城市規劃。ngo5 soeng2 zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1, jan1 wai6 ngo5 zung1 ji3 jung6 sou3 geoi3 bong1 sing4 si5 kwai1 waak6
我覺得呢個職位好適合我。ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 zik1 wai6 hou2 sik1 hap6 ngo5
有，我想問吓團隊而家最重要嘅研究課題係咩。
多謝你哋今日嘅時間，我好期待有機會加入。(audio: wed04_intro_addons.mp3 + tue03_yue_lines.mp3)

questions.q: Tone number for 事 in 有咩事呀？
questions.explain: 事 si6, low flat. Not 試 si3 or 時 si4.

questions.q: Jyutping for 合作 (tones, space between syllables).
questions.explain: hap6 zok3; same 作 as 工作 gung1 zok3.
強項 koeng4 hong6 = strength / strong suit.
jin4 gau3, low rising then mid.

questions.q: Interviewer says 有冇問題問我哋. A solid reply starts with…
questions.explain: Yes + one real question about the team or the role's first-year work.
時 si4 (low falling), 間 gaan3. Common trap: saying si3.
課題 fo1 tai4 = research topic / subject of study.
